build-digital.title: Connect the computer
build-digital.prompt: Connect the computer to the transceiver for FT8.

blocks.label: Sound-card interface
blocks.does: couples audio both ways and keys the transmitter

blocks.label: Transceiver
blocks.does: turns audio into RF and back

blocks.does: matches the antenna; it doesn't connect to the computer
